description: Send a DM from the USER'S OWN X account. FREE. This actually sends: there is no undo, and the founder sees the user, not Frontrun. NEVER call this without showing the exact message to the user first and getting them to say yes. Requires confirm: true, which you may only set after they have approved that specific text; if you call without it you get the draft echoed back and nothing is sent. Off by default per account, and capped per day, because these calls run through a shared X app. If it fails with a closed inbox, do not retry: suggest the company account or a public reply instead.

company.description: Company handle this relates to, for the audit record

confirm.description: Must be true, and only after the user approved this exact message. Without it nothing sends.

grounded_in.description: Pass through the grounded_in block from frontrun_draft_dm so the claims are recorded alongside the send

message.description: The exact text to send, as approved by the user

name: frontrun_send_dm
